premises.text: A large share of smartphone users lack internet access, creating life-critical and socio-economic connectivity gaps
premises.evidence_span: 66% of the world has a smartphone in their hands, but 53% of the population does not have access to internet

premises.text: An SDK lets existing apps work offline by connecting phones over Bluetooth mesh networks with hop routing and a flood/battery-aware algorithm
premises.evidence_span: SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: The mesh stack uniquely supports Android-to-iOS integration and is encrypted and patented
premises.evidence_span: only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration. We are encrypted, and we're patented

premises.text: Go-to-market is B2B to developers who already have user density rather than building a rival consumer app
premises.evidence_span: working on a B2B model. We cater to developers that already have this user density

premises.text: Pricing charges on monthly active users who use the partner app thanks to the offline technology
premises.evidence_span: charge based on monthly active users that use your app thanks to our technology each month

value.text: Apps and people can communicate without internet, including in emergencies that can save lives
value.evidence_span: being able to connect with rescue corps

secondary_value.text: Open and grow markets for developers, translating into revenue
secondary_value.evidence_span: You open up new markets. You open and you blow up existing ones. So that translates into revenue

causal_links.evidence_span: connects phones directly using their Bluetooth antennas
cater to developers that already have this user density
when developers make this revenue, we also make it

notes: WhatsApp/Uber/broadcast examples folded as uses of the same mesh SDK. IP/encryption folded into mesh feasibility with cross-platform claim. Fundraising and user-count traction excluded. Closing vision partly truncated.
